notes: The app downloads only entries in this file. Size and sha256 are filled when the spike pins a build. A model with export_status other than ready is listed so the choice is visible, and the app keeps it disabled.

hardware_profiles.note: The 32GB MacBook Pro M4 is the 10-core chip. The Mac pack is built for this machine. Both speech models stay resident. Default preset is accurate.
1TB is storage. RAM is 12GB, bandwidth about 77 GB/s. The live set stays near 7GB of weights. Default preset is accurate. Both speech models stay resident.

models.title: Typhoon ASR Streaming 0.6B
models.note: Best streaming Thai model. Full precision on the 32GB M4. Int8 on the iPhone 17 Pro Max. Default chunk 1040 ms on both. Keeps English words mixed into Thai. Paper: arXiv:2609.14991.

models.title: Typhoon ASR Streaming 0.6B n-gram
models.note: Paired 4-gram for the 0.6B Thai model. On for both packs. Raises keyword recall at the 1040 ms point. First thing dropped on the phone if a chunk misses.

models.title: Typhoon ASR Streaming 115M
models.note: iPhone default. Weaker on English mixed into Thai. Streaming CER 19.4% on TVSpeech at 1040 ms. Attribute SCB 10X / Typhoon in the model screen.

models.title: Nemotron 3.5 ASR Streaming 0.6B, English
models.note: English is transcription-ready. Full precision on the 32GB M4, int8 on the iPhone 17 Pro Max. Default chunk 1120 ms. Kept resident on both target machines. Thai on this checkpoint is adaptation-ready and is not used. Community conversions are spike inputs, not the pinned release.

models.title: ChindaMT 4B, 4-bit
models.note: iPhone 17 Pro Max translation model. Same ChindaMT-4B weights as the Mac, 4-bit so it fits beside int8 speech and the 3B notes model. Conversion notes: 2.7 GB, 94.6% semantic fidelity, 37/100 prompts identical to bf16. Re-time on the A19 Pro.

models.title: ChindaMT 4B, 8-bit
models.note: Mac translation model for the 32GB M4. MLX 8-bit conversion of iapp/ChindaMT-4B. Conversion notes: 99.3% semantic fidelity, 81/100 prompts identical to bf16, 72 tok/s on an M3 Max. Re-time on this M4 before treating that speed as ours.

models.title: ChindaMT 4B, bf16
models.note: Fits in 32GB. Identical to the original weights on the converter's 100-prompt check. 39 tok/s was measured on an M3 Max. Becomes the Mac model only if a short turn stays inside the lag budget on this M4.

models.title: ChindaMT 0.8B
models.note: Phone fallback if ChindaMT-4B 4-bit misses the lag budget or the 12GB memory limit.

models.title: Hy-MT2 1.8B
models.note: Disabled. Multilingual fallback, including Thai, with a 1.25-bit GGUF Tencent describes as 440 MB. Empty platforms until the license is written into this file.

models.title: Typhoon 2 7B Instruct, 4-bit
models.note: Mac live notes. Reads committed turns in the translation language and maintains a meeting note: title, summary, decisions, actions, open questions. Scheduled behind ChindaMT. About 4.3 GB. Too large to keep resident on the 12GB phone beside the rest of the pack. Source weights are Typhoon 2 Qwen2.5 7B Instruct.

models.title: Typhoon 2 3B Instruct, 4-bit
models.note: iPhone 17 Pro Max live notes. Same prompt and JSON as the 7B Mac model. A 3B 4-bit file is on the order of 2 GB. The spike records the real size and the lag.

models.title: FluidAudio LS-EEND
models.note: Swift package FluidInference/FluidAudio. Online diarization, up to 10 speakers. The library downloads its own Core ML weights. Session labels only. No voice enrollment.

packs.title: MacBook Pro M4 32GB, best
packs.note: Both speech models stay loaded. Live notes run on committed turns behind translation. ChindaMT-4B bf16 is the translation upgrade if the M4 spike clears the lag budget.

packs.title: iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB
packs.note: Int8 speech, 4-bit ChindaMT-4B, Typhoon 2 3B notes. Both speech models stay resident. The n-gram is dropped first if a chunk misses. The 115M Thai model is the thermal fallback and is not in this pack.
